title: 1RB0LE_1LC1RA_1RA1LD_0LC0LA_0RE1RF_0RC---: DeepMind's map iterated to 1.8·10<sup>24</sup> steps, no halt
text: A batched iterator (c/fast.c) jumps runs of left steps from tables indexed by m mod 3L and jumps each wall sweep; both shortcuts are proved for DeepMind's map in Lean (lean/Batch.lean). Six hours took the orbit from 3.3·1021 to 1.81·1024 map steps (9.16·1036 machine steps, sizes 7·1012) without a visit to m = 3b + 1. No new near miss came after size 1.3·1011; a random model expected about 3.3 hits by now.
